output.summary: KEP-2589 is a vendor-specific KEP that migrates the Portworx in-tree volume plugin to the Portworx CSI driver by enabling Portworx-specific CSI Migration feature gates, inheriting its design from parent KEP-625 (CSI Migration). Its status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: Portworx volume provisioning ran through the in-tree driver, so it needed to be migrated to the Portworx CSI driver as part of the parent CSI Migration KEP. The core in-tree to CSI migration code already existed in k/k, so this KEP only adds Portworx-specific feature gates. The sources do not explain the reasons for the timeline (beta and stable targets moved across releases), so only the design rationale is stated here.

alternatives.option: Track the work as a standalone design proposal in the old design-proposal format
alternatives.why_not: The enhancements team said the proposal must use the KEP format, with a metadata file and a PRR review, to be accepted into a milestone.

alternatives.option: Close the enhancement issue and track the work only under the parent KEP-625
alternatives.why_not: The enhancements team suggested this as an option if the parent KEP was the way the SIG targeted milestones, but the sources do not record that this was done.

alternatives.option: Write a new migration design instead of reusing the parent CSI Migration design
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the KEP inherits all contents from its parent KEP and that the core migration code is out of scope, so only feature gates are added.

evidence.quote: This inherits all the contents from its parent KEP. It will introduce two new feature gates to be used as described in its parent KEP.
The in-tree to CSI migration feature is already in place in k/k. We just need to enable Portworx specific feature gates for it to work for Portworx driver.
Currently the Portworx volume provisioning happens through Portworx in-tree driver. As part of the parent KEP
